old: 0.30 fire hotfix (0.31.15) - Fires stay fixed on the burning part of the ship instead of sliding around the deck - Fire size follows the ship and the fire: a single fire is small, a ship burning end to end has big fires in several places 0.30 Mega Patch 01 New - Allied AI: RAN task forces (yellow) patrol, fight, escort your merchants and supply your ports - Your starting RAN force in the Allied campaign sails under RAN command - Sea auto resolve for battles your allies fight - Enemy AI rework, scaled by difficulty from Very Easy to Elite (switches in Mod Options) - Enemy floatplanes and flying boats scout from every airfield; a pop-up names the force they spot - Enemy strikes gather and attack together, sized to the ships they go for - The enemy hunts you harder on the map; in battle it presses home and finishes cripples - More aircraft types at every enemy airfield (new campaigns) - Downed airmen show on the map; flying boats, floatplanes and ships pick them up - Auto rescue button on the campaign map - Real 3D animated ship fires that grow with every burning compartment and light up the sea - Shell and bomb hits burst in 3D fire, smoke and sparks - Every surface ship has torn, burnt break pieces - Wrecks and broken halves sink on real physics: they flood, list, roll over or stand on end - Real turning circles, rudder lag and momentum for every ship - CHANGE LOG button in the main menu Changes - A magazine blast can tear any ship apart, even a battleship - Torpedo break-back stays for destroyers and escorts - The Pacific War campaign is in as "Experimental. WIP might not work" - Nebraska (1944) removed from the ship lists Fixes - The supply convoy sat still; it now sails to your port and unloads - The battle message log carried over from the last battle 0.29 - Ships capsize, plunge by the bow or stern, or settle, by their flooding - Torpedoes can break a destroyer's back: two magazine blasts, then she splits - Magazine blasts sized by what is in them, in a new HMS Barham style - Torpedo hits throw up a huge splash (the game's own, made bigger) - Floating wreckage and spreading oil slicks where ships sink - Shot planes shed real wings, tails, engines; crews bail out by parachute - Air auto resolve window restyled to match the game - Mod models now live in StreamingAssets/override/ModAssets - Your ships answer your controls again; fewer planes explode - Plus the 0.28 air combat update (0.28.18 and hotfix)
